name: call_qr_over_equation_budget_rejected
source:
{ A 130x130 QR emits 130^2 (Q) + 130^2 (R) = 33800 equations on top of the
  16900 the identity literal already cost, far over the 25000 generation
  budget. Both engines refuse with the same message. }
A = eye(130)
CALL QR(A : Q, R)

error.message: Too many equations generated (over 25000). Reduce loop or array sizes.
